        min_created_at='2023-05-01',

            title = match.group(1).strip()
            artist = match.group(2).strip()

spotify_token = spotify_login['access_token']
song_ids = []
for song in songs_to_archive:
    query = f"{song['title']} {song['artist']}"
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
    # Find matching song
    found = None
    for r in results:
        if r['title'].lower() == song['title'].lower():
            # Check artist match
            artists = [a['name'].lower() for a in r['artists']]
            if song['artist'].lower() in artists:
                found = r
                break
    if found:
        song_ids.append(found['song_id'])

print(f"\nTotal found: {len(song_ids)}")

# Parse the songs_to_archive content to extract song titles and artists
content_lines = file_data['content'].strip().split('\n')
songs_to_archive = []
for line in content_lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        song_str = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " to get title and artist
        if ' by ' in song_str:
            title, artist = song_str.split(' by ', 1)
            songs_to_archive.append((title.strip(), artist.strip()))
print(songs_to_archive)

# Parse the file content to get list of songs to archive
lines = file_content.strip().split('\n')
songs_to_archive = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artists_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
        songs_to_archive.append((title, artists))
    else:
        # fallback: treat whole line as title
        songs_to_archive.append((line.strip(), []))
print(songs_to_archive)

# Parse the note content to extract songs and artists
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line[2:]
        # Split by " BY " to get title and artists part
        if ' BY ' in line:
            title_part, artists_part = line.split(' BY ', 1)
            # artists_part may contain " RELEASED_AT ..."
            if ' RELEASED_AT ' in artists_part:
                artists, released = artists_part.split(' RELEASED_AT ', 1)
            else:
                artists = artists_part
                released = None
            songs.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists.strip(), 'released': released.strip() if released else None})
        else:
            # No BY? skip
            pass
print(songs)

todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Remove leading "- " and split on " BY "
        line_clean = line.strip()
        if line_clean.startswith('- '):
            line_clean = line_clean[2:]
        # Split on " BY " to get title and artists
        parts = line_clean.split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            artists_str = parts[1].strip()
            # Remove the " RELEASED_AT TODO" part
            artists_str = artists_str.replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '').strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            todo_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
print(todo_songs)

- When All Words Fail Us BY Marcus Lane RELEASED_AT TODO
- Final Echo BY Hazel Winter RELEASED_AT TODO
"""

lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip first line "# Songs I have Liked"
songs = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line.startswith('- '):
        continue
    # Remove leading "- "
    line = line[2:]
    # Split on " BY " to get title and rest
    if ' BY ' not in line:
        continue
    title_part, rest = line.split(' BY ', 1)
    # rest contains artists and RELEASED_AT
    # Split on " RELEASED_AT " to get artists and release
    if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest:
        artists_part, release = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ', 1)
    else:
        artists_part = rest
        release = ''
    artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
    songs.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'release': release.strip()})

print(songs)

steps.code:
# Parse the note content to extract songs that need release month
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        m = re.match(r'^- (.+) BY (.+) RELEASED_AT TODO$', line)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            todo_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
        else:
            print("Could not parse line:", line)

print("Number of TODO songs:", len(todo_songs))
for s in todo_songs:
    print(s['title'], "|", s['artists'])

        # Remove leading "- " and split on " BY "
        parts = line.split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title_part = parts[0].strip()
            # title_part starts with "- " so remove that
            title = title_part[2:].strip()
            rest = parts[1]
            # rest ends with " RELEASED_AT TODO"
            artists_str = rest.replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '').strip()
            artists = tuple(a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(','))

            if key in release_month_map:

                new_line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f'RELEASED_AT {month_year}')

    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title: line starts with "- " then title before " BY "
        # Example: "- Lost in the Embrace of Night BY Noah Bennett RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Split by " BY " to get title part
        parts = line.split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            title_part = parts[0].strip()
            # Remove leading "- " if present
            if title_part.startswith('- '):
                title = title_part[2:].strip()
            else:
                title = title_part.strip()
            if title in release_map:
                new_line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f'RELEASED_AT {release_map[title]}')
                new_lines.append(new_line)
            else:
                new_lines.append(line)  # keep as is if not found

# Parse the TODO lines to extract title and artists
import re

parsed = []
for line in todo_lines:
    # Remove leading "- " and split
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " BY " and " RELEASED_AT "
    parts = line.split(' BY ')
    if len(parts) == 2:
        title = parts[0].strip()
        rest = parts[1].split(' RELEASED_AT ')[0].strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in rest.split(',')]
        parsed.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
    else:
        print("Parse issue:", line)

print(parsed)

# Build mapping from song title to release month/year
import re
from datetime import datetime

# Create mapping from song_id to release_date (already have release_dates dict)
# Create mapping from title to release month/year
title_to_month_year = {}
for song in liked_songs:
    sid = song['song_id']
    title = song['title']
    if sid in release_dates:
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(release_dates[sid])
        month_year = f"{dt.month:02d}/{dt.year}"
        title_to_month_year[title] = month_year

# Now parse the note content and replace TODO entries
lines = note['content'].split('\n')
new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title: part before " BY "
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # We'll split on " BY " and take first part after "- "
        parts = line.split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            title_part = parts[0].strip()
            # Remove leading "- " if present
            if title_part.startswith('- '):
                title_part = title_part[2:]
            title = title_part.strip()
            if title in title_to_month_year:
                month_year = title_to_month_year[title]
                line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f'RELEASED_AT {month_year}')
            else:
                print(f"Warning: no release date found for title: {title}")
    new_lines.append(line)

new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print(new_content)

        # Split by " BY " to get title and rest

# Define a helper to extract month/year from release_date
def get_month_year(release_date):
    # release_date format: "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"
    date_part = release_date.split('T')[0]
    year, month, _ = date_part.split('-')
    return f"{month}/{year}"

# Test with the first song
print(get_month_year("2021-03-23T13:53:26"))

# Search for each TODO song and find the matching song
import re

# We'll store results in a dict: title -> (month, year)
release_info = {}

for song in todo_songs:
    title = song['title']
    artists = song['artists']
    # Search
    result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
    # Find matching song
    found = None
    for item in result:
        if item['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check artists match
            item_artists = [a['name'] for a in item['artists']]
            # Check if all expected artists are in item_artists and vice versa
            if set(artists) == set(item_artists):
                found = item
                break
    if found:
        release_date = found['release_date']
        month_year = get_month_year(release_date)
        release_info[title] = month_year
        print(f"Found: {title} -> {month_year}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {title}")

print("Done searching")

# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- "
        line_clean = line.lstrip('- ').strip()
        # Split on " BY " to get title and rest
        if ' BY ' in line_clean:
            title_part, rest = line_clean.split(' BY ', 1)
            # rest contains "Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
            # Remove " RELEASED_AT TODO" at end
            artists_part = rest.replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '').strip()
            # Split artists by comma
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
            todo_songs.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
        else:
            print("Unexpected format:", line_clean)
print("Number of TODO songs:", len(todo_songs))
print(todo_songs)

# Build mapping from (title, artists) to song_id from liked_songs
liked_map = {}
for song in liked_songs:
    title = song['title']
    artists = tuple(sorted([a['name'] for a in song['artists']]))
    liked_map[(title, artists)] = song['song_id']

# Build mapping from song_id to release month/year
release_month = {}
for sid, date_str in release_dates.items():
    # date_str is like "2021-03-23T13:53:26"
    year = int(date_str[:4])
    month = int(date_str[5:7])
    release_month[sid] = f"{month:02d}/{year}"

# Now parse the note content and replace TODO lines
lines = note['content'].split('\n')
new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract title and artists from the line
        # Format: "- Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- " and split on " BY " and " RELEASED_AT "
        parts = line.split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title_part = parts[0].lstrip('- ').strip()
            rest = parts[1]
            # rest is "Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
            artist_part = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ')[0].strip()
            artists = tuple(sorted([a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(',')]))
            key = (title_part, artists)
            if key in liked_map:
                sid = liked_map[key]
                if sid in release_month:
                    new_line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f"RELEASED_AT {release_month[sid]}")
                    new_lines.append(new_line)
                    continue
        # If we couldn't find, keep as is (shouldn't happen)
        new_lines.append(line)
    else:
        new_lines.append(line)

new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print(new_content)

        rest = line[2:]  # remove "- "

            # artist_part ends with " RELEASED_AT TODO"

# Search for each song and collect release dates
import re

# We'll store results in a dict mapping line to release month/year
release_dates = {}

for entry in song_entries:
    title = entry['title']
    artists = entry['artists']
    # Build query: title + artist names
    query = title + " " + " ".join(artists)
    result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=1)
    if result:
        song = result[0]
        # Verify it's the correct song
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check artists match
            song_artist_names = [a['name'].lower() for a in song['artists']]
            expected_artists = [a.lower() for a in artists]
            if all(any(exp in sa or sa in exp for exp in expected_artists) for sa in song_artist_names):
                release_date = song['release_date']  # e.g., "2021-03-23T13:53:26"
                # Extract month and year
                dt = release_date[:10]  # "2021-03-23"
                year, month, _ = dt.split('-')
                release_dates[entry['line']] = f"{month}/{year}"
                print(f"Found: {title} -> {month}/{year}")
            else:
                print(f"Artist mismatch for {title}: {song_artist_names} vs {expected_artists}")
        else:
            print(f"Title mismatch for {title}: got {song['title']}")
    else:
        print(f"No result for {title}")

print("Collected release dates:", release_dates)

# Let's search for each song and get the release date
import re

# We'll store results: (original_line, new_line)
updates = []

for line, title, artists in todo_lines:
    # Build query: title + artist names
    query = title + " " + " ".join(artists)
    # Search with page_limit=20 to get more results
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
    # Find exact match: title matches and all artists match
    found = None
    for song in results:
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            song_artists = [a['name'].lower() for a in song['artists']]
            expected_artists = [a.lower() for a in artists]
            if all(any(exp in sa for sa in song_artists) for exp in expected_artists) and len(song_artists) == len(expected_artists):
                found = song
                break
    if found:
        release_date = found['release_date']  # e.g., "2021-03-23T13:53:26"
        # Extract month and year
        dt = release_date.split('T')[0]  # "2021-03-23"
        year, month, _ = dt.split('-')
        month_year = f"{int(month)}/{year}"
        # Replace TODO with month/year
        new_line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f'RELEASED_AT {month_year}')
        updates.append((line, new_line))
        print(f"{title} -> {month_year}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {title}")

# Now we have all the release dates. Let's create a mapping from song title to release month/year.
release_map = {
    "Silver Lining": "12/2022",
    "Walking Through the Valley of Shadows": "08/2022",
    "Where Shadows Come to Life": "01/2023",
    "Eternal Melancholy": "04/2023",
    "Crimson Veil": "01/2020",
    "Elusive Joy": "03/2021",
    "Ephemeral Beauty": "01/2020",
    "Stardust Serenade": "04/2019",
    "Veiled Behind a Mask of Joy": "10/2022",
    "In the Wake of Unspoken Promises": "07/2022",
    "Wading Through the Ashes of Love": "09/2020",
    "Fading Like a Distant Star": "01/2019",
    "Wilted Grace": "01/2022"
}

# Get the current note content
note_content = note['content']
lines = note_content.split('\n')
new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if "RELEASED_AT TODO" in line:
        # Extract the song title from the line: format "- <title> BY <artists> RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # The title is between "- " and " BY "
        title = line.split(" BY ")[0].lstrip("- ").strip()
        if title in release_map:
            line = line.replace("RELEASED_AT TODO", f"RELEASED_AT {release_map[title]}")
    new_lines.append(line)
new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print(new_content)

import re

lines = note_content.split('\n')
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract title and artist
        # Format: "- Title BY Artist RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- " and trailing " RELEASED_AT TODO"
        song_part = line.strip().lstrip('- ').replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '')
        # Split on " BY " to get title and artist
        if ' BY ' in song_part:
            title, artist = song_part.split(' BY ', 1)
            todo_songs.append((title.strip(), artist.strip(), line))
        else:
            print("Could not parse line:", line)

print("TODO songs count:", len(todo_songs))
for t, a, l in todo_songs:

# Check if there is a play/start API in Spotify
print(apis.api_docs.show_api_descriptions(app_name='spotify'))

# Get the current song queue to see which positions contain liked songs
queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
print(queue)

# Identify positions of liked songs in the queue and remove them (from highest to lowest to avoid index shifting)
liked_ids = {19, 103, 109, 133, 135, 167, 204, 206, 229, 242, 301}
positions_to_remove = [song['position'] for song in queue if song['song_id'] in liked_ids]
print("Positions to remove:", positions_to_remove)

# Remove from highest position to lowest
for pos in sorted(positions_to_remove, reverse=True):
    result = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_queue(position=pos, access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Removed position {pos}: {result}")

# Verify the queue after removal
queue_after = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
print("Queue after removal:")
for song in queue_after:
    print(f"Position {song['position']}: song_id={song['song_id']}, title={song['title']}, is_current={song['is_current']}")

# Remove liked songs from queue, starting from the highest position to avoid index shifting
